Sectoare de activitate: Fabricația de componente hardware pentru computere, Dezvoltare de software și Securitate și investigații
Job description:
Solves and documents Level 1 and sometimes Level 2 IT needs of users and productive operations associated with a ticket
Supports the installation and maintenance of operating systems, software and applications within the right standards and processes
Manages communication with internal and external customer from the point of raising request to the resolution in partnership with other departments
Assists external providers or vendors during certain IT activities and ensures they work in compliance with the company standards
Manages IT assets (computer and communications equipment, servers, and licenses)
Manages and coordinates access to IT tools while ensuring compliance with security standards
Gives support to the server infrastructure, virtualization, communications, and security to guarantee its availability
Contributes to IT Strategy definition
Liaises with internal customers to ensure service is in line with business needs
Manages an IT Team and ensures that the IT strategy and processes are properly followed by the team
Profile description:
 We are looking for a Senior VMware & Infrastructure Administrator with 5–8 years of experience in enterprise environments.
 The ideal candidate is a VMware specialist with strong Linux and Windows administration skills, capable of supporting and improving critical infrastructure platforms. Beyond day-to-day operations, they should be comfortable handling complex technical issues, automation initiatives, and infrastructure improvement projects.
 This position is primarily focused on Operations / Run activities (L1/L2/L3 support).
 Required Skills 
 • Strong experience with VMware vSphere, vCenter and ESXi.
 • Good administration knowledge of Linux and Windows Server.
 • Hands-on experience with enterprise Storage technologies (SAN, NAS, vSAN).
 • Hands-on experience with Backup and Recovery solutions (Veeam, Commvault).
 • Good understanding of Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity concepts.
 • Knowledge of networking fundamentals.
 • Scripting and automation skills (Ansible).
 • Strong troubleshooting and analytical capabilities.
 Bonus Skills 
 • Experience with CI/CD tools and practices (GitLab CI, Jenkins).
 • Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible).
 • Experience automating infrastructure and operational tasks using PowerShell, Python, Bash, or Ansible.
 The role is a short term contract for 2 years (replacement due to parental leave).
